# Systema Sanscriticum — Sanskrit online-learning platform

> Laravel platform of the Sanskrit school (samskrtam.ru): student cabinet with dictionary, homework and SRS, course shop, funnels and admin panel — public promo and status pages.

## Pages

- [Promo / home](https://gasyoun.github.io/Systema-Sanscriticum/): platform landing — student cabinet, course shop, admin panel overview.
- [Uptime status](https://gasyoun.github.io/Systema-Sanscriticum/uptime/): public service-uptime dashboard for the platform.

Source: https://github.com/gasyoun/Systema-Sanscriticum
